newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end higher after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end higher after choppy session.

text.p: Manila shares were slightly higher at the end of a subdued session, the index gaining 1.15 points to close the week at 3,223.71, brokers said.
"Most of the major issues have taken the back seat. Investors were putting a premium on secondliners with exciting concepts," Jonas Ferrer of Pryce Securities said.
Leading the gainers was newly listed MUSIC Semiconductors Corp which rose another 50 centavos to close at 8.30 pesos.
The composite index were languishing in negative territory through most of the session due to the weakness in heavyweights such as PLDT and Philippine National Bank.
Allan Araullo of Regina Capital Development Corp said the Ayala companies, which were bought up at the last minute, were able to pull the index higher.
The general market was mixed, with mining and property issues heading higher, while the oils and commercial-industrial stocks slipping.
Gainers and losers were even, with 52 stocks in each column. - RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
